notes.title: Patch #4 (v0.152)
notes.content:
Radar menu has been completely remade
Remade projectile visuals
Some skills were re-balanced
Added game object - energy batteries
Added brief controls help (F1)
Added random encounter - rabbit holes
Added automatic recovery feature (on low HP)
Energy bars recovers faster now, if skill are not being used
Active effects added to UI screen
More level variety
Added global difficulty (lowers on death, increases on various successful actions)
Minor fixes and improvements

notes.title: Patch #3 (v0.140)
notes.content:
Added more explosion types
Different explosion on death, if enemy ship is frozen
Added new anomaly types and refined older types
Changed package structure
Some destroyes enemies drop energy orbs, that can restore some power, fuel or hull shields
Stop all game sounds in pause menu
Pause menu refined a little
Added sound upon enemy spawning
Fixed minor bugs in controls menu
Changed distance of disabling logic for some game objects

notes.title: Patch #2 (v0.129)
notes.content:
Added autosave after intro sequence
 Tweaked intro sounds
 Added 3 blueprints after intro
 Fixed skill assignment indicator
 Added animations to fractal shapes in the background
 Shields now blocking mostly projectiles like missiles or bolts, but not auras or energy sword

notes.title: Patch #1 (v0.125)
notes.content:
Fixed rebinding gamepad controls
 Setted limits for increasing stats in development menu
 Collision margin increases if player moves too fast (to prevent stucking in other objects)
 Tweaked intro sounds
 Added sound for energy stream trap (around artefacts and voyager probe)
 Refined artefact and voyager activities: now traps placed in less scattered manner, navigating through them in now easier
